chinese: 圣人不病，以其病病，是以不病。
pinyin: Zhī bù zhī shàng， bù zhī zhī bìng。
Fū wéi bìng bìng， shì yǐ bù bìng。
Shèng rén bù bìng， yǐ qí bìng bìng， shì yǐ bù bìng。
english: Knowing you don't know is wholeness. Thinking you know is a disease. Only by recognizing that you have an illness can you move to seek a cure.
The Master is whole because she sees her illnesses and treats them, and thus is able to remain whole.
